scope: UI only; local fixtures, not Google UAT
choice_scenarios: one customer input, 20-row cap and screen reader status at 390px
accented/accentless/case-insensitive name, phone substring and address select the same validated customer ID
machine model/serial search and switching customers refreshes machines, auto-selects a sole machine
clear removes ID; free text without selection cannot save, Escape closes only the list
keyboard Tab/Enter creates customer with phone prefilled; cancelling restores query and draft
no-match creates customer with typed name prefilled, selects new ID and preserves order draft
TD combo shows code/name/unit/warehouse/stock; warehouse refresh, clear, invalid text and explicit outside-catalogue choice
short lists are 48px quick buttons with keyboard navigation; no horizontal overflow at 390px
Finance source and target share the same component, searchable by name or exact ID
